instruction: Cinematic full shot of an indoor boxing ring. On the left, the trainer in the black and orange jumpsuit (R1) stands facing right, holding up her right red focus mitt. On the right, the boxer in the white sports bra (R2) stands facing left, throwing a left punch with her black glove to strike the trainer's mitt. Black punching bags hang in the background under cool overhead gym lights.
